info.title: Cuna API
info.description: Authoritative Cuna control-plane contract. JSON responses are UTF-8, redirects are not API successes, and x-sdk-exposed defaults to false.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: Required for machine and agent_session scopes; forbidden for account scope.

200.description: Fresh authenticated capability snapshot. Discovery does not authorize a mutation.

ETag.description: Quoted digest of the capability semantics and subject.

Cache-Control.description: Private cache lease bounded by expires_at.

Vary.description: Capability evidence is authentication- and CORS-origin dependent.

get.description: Deprecated machine-scoped alias of `agentSessions.agentAuth`. It remains published so already-released SDKs keep working; new callers SHALL use `GET /v1/agent-sessions/{id}/agent-auth`, which reports the exact AgentSession process generation.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page.

200.description: Bounded page of owned AgentSessions for one owned Machine.

201.description: Durable launch intent. process_state remains unknown until a leased supervisor acknowledgement.

200.description: Exact durable AgentSession create intent recovered with the original user-scoped idempotency key.

Cache-Control.description: Recovery evidence is never reusable through an HTTP cache.

200.description: Low-information authentication state for the exact owned AgentSession process generation.

Cache-Control.description: Authentication evidence is never reusable through an HTTP cache.

200.description: Confirmation that provider credentials were removed from the exact current AgentSession process generation.

Cache-Control.description: Provider sign-out results are never reusable through an HTTP cache.

200.description: Owned AgentSession intent and runtime observation.
Renamed AgentSession metadata; process facts are unchanged.
Durable termination intent. Success does not assert process absence.

201.description: Short-lived Cuna terminal connection grant. The one-use connect token is returned separately and is never embedded in the URL.

200.description: Non-secret fail-closed CLI sign-in bootstrap metadata.
Fail-closed self-service signup capability. Enabled signup is always waitlist-only.

201.description: Short-lived browser continuation. The only browser proof is carried in the fragment URL; no continuation secret is returned to the CLI.

200.description: Browser-authorized cancellation bound to the one-shot nonce and state proof.
Browser identity approved; the login code is returned exactly once and must not be cached.

Reusable login-code exchange bound to the original continuation, client, profile, state, redirect and S256 verifier. Each successful exchange mints only short-lived access and never returns or rotates the login code.
Current CLI token family and its bound Cuna login code are atomically revoked.
Current separate identity, admission and auto-assigned workspace state.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional retry key. A repeated identical request returns the same metadata without re-emitting the one-time secret; a different request with the same key is rejected.

201.description: Created secret (shown once) or an idempotent replay containing metadata only.

200.description: Created, replayed, or exactly adopted canonical workspace binding

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Public workspace identifier. Authorization is resolved server-side for the authenticated user.

parameters.description: Opaque public workspace identifier. It is not a WorkspaceBinding identifier.

RunaApiKey.description: Programmatic Cuna API key. Not valid for key-management operations.

CunaHumanBearer.description: Short-lived opaque Cuna CLI human access token.

AgentSessionId.name: id
AgentSessionId.description: Opaque AgentSession identifier; never interchangeable with a Machine ID.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-stable retry identity. The plaintext value is never persisted.

MachineCreateRequestId.name: X-Cuna-Machine-Create-Request-Id
MachineCreateRequestId.description: Optional caller-generated UUID that identifies the durable machine-create request. New clients send it before the first attempt and reuse it to inspect or reconcile an uncertain outcome after a lost response.

Problem.description: Typed safe problem for additive operations

WorkspaceSyncProblem.description: Closed workspace-sync problem. Negotiation metadata is present only when a protocol was selected.

RuntimeUrl.description: Cuna producers emit only cunacode.cloud. Consumers temporarily accept the exact runacode.cloud predecessor during the 1.7 expand phase.

redirect_uri.description: Exact loopback URI bound into the S256 exchange proof. The producer never redirects to it; the user pastes the browser-issued login code into the CLI.

browser_url.description: Exact deployment-approved HTTPS browser origin with fragment-only continuation proof; the runtime validates the configured production or isolated staging origin.

completion_mode.description: After browser approval, paste the bounded Cuna login code into the CLI.

required_terms_version.description: Authoritative terms version that governed the cancelled browser continuation.

login_code.description: Shown exactly once after approval. Never place in URL, history, storage, logs, analytics, cache, manifest, or product Authorization headers.

redirect_uri.description: Exact loopback URI bound into the original S256 approval; no callback listener or polling is required for the paste-code UX.

login_code_expires_at.description: Authoritative expiry of the reusable login code. Repeated exchanges return the same expiry and never the code itself.

AgentAuth.description: Deprecated machine-scoped authentication state returned by `sessions.agentAuth`. It carries no process generation and is preserved only for already-released SDKs.

AgentSessionAuth.description: Short-lived, process-generation-bound authentication evidence. Consumers must reject observations after valid_until and must match agent_session_id, process_epoch, and auth_mode to the AgentSession they already admitted.

AgentSessionAuthLogout.description: Exact process-generation confirmation for an AgentSession-scoped provider sign-out.

workspace_binding_id.description: Immutable canonical WorkspaceBinding selected for this AgentSession. Omitted only for legacy rows created before binding authority; never contains a private sync namespace.

workspace_generation.description: Immutable committed workspace generation selected for this AgentSession.

process_state.description: Observed runtime fact. It is unknown until a current leased supervisor acknowledgement.

runtime_expires_at.description: Authoritative expiry of the current leased supervisor observation. Omitted when no runtime lease exists.

workspace_binding_id.description: Opaque canonical WorkspaceBinding identifier. The producer validates its authenticated Machine parent and current generation before mutation.

client_instance_id.description: Caller-stable Cuna client instance identity used for attachment fencing.

resume_handle.description: Previously issued Cuna resume handle. Omit for a new attachment generation.

availability.description: Explicit Cuna observation. Support is never inferred from omission.

connect_url.description: Secret-free Cuna WebSocket URL. It contains no token, query, fragment, provider host, or runtime identifier.

connect_token.description: One-use Cuna terminal connection token. Plaintext is never persisted and is never placed in connect_url.

capabilities.description: Complete explicit Cuna capability set. Every known capability appears exactly once with supported, unsupported, or unknown availability.

expires_at.description: Expiry of the unredeemed one-use connection grant.

background.description: When true, provisioning may continue asynchronously and the 201 response may contain status creating. Omission or false preserves synchronous creation.

ConsoleCreateSession.description: The deployed console accepts additional non-SDK fields; x-sdk-request-schema is authoritative for SDK generation.

url.description: Single-use handoff URL. Cuna producers emit only cunacode.cloud; the exact runacode.cloud predecessor remains response-compatible during the 1.7 expand phase.

completion_mode.description: The browser displays the reusable-until-expiry Cuna login code exactly once.

browser_origin.description: Null while disabled; otherwise the exact approved browser origin.

workspace_id.description: Public workspace identifier. Internal tenant and synchronization namespace identifiers are never accepted.

items.description: Canonical portable relative workspace prefix. Absolute paths, traversal, control characters, backslashes, and device paths are rejected.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. UTC and explicit numeric offsets are accepted.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. UTC and explicit numeric offsets are accepted.

workspace_binding_id.description: Canonical WorkspaceBinding child of the public workspace in the request path.
Canonical WorkspaceBinding child of the public workspace in the request path.
